Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to disambiguate the search results for "David Eady," retrieving data for a modern individual (born 1947, died 2025) instead of the film director (born 1924, died 2009). Despite the search results explicitly listing the correct director's death date (April 5, 2009) on the IMDb link, the agent incorrectly concluded the death date was April 5, 1962, likely due to a hallucination or misreading of the conflicting data presented in the search snippets. This error led to an incorrect comparison of death dates, as the agent compared 1962 (Lew Landers) against the erroneous 1962 (David Eady) rather than the correct 2009.
